basic_profile.bio: I'm a 19-year-old college student from California, currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science. I have a passion for gaming, especially DotA 2, and I spend a lot of my free time strategizing and playing with friends online. I'm also a big fan of historical strategy games like Europa Universalis IV. When I'm not gaming, I'm usually busy with coding projects or exploring new tech trends. I'm single and trying to navigate the dating scene, which can be quite a challenge! I typically browse Reddit in the evenings after classes and on weekends. I'm not a morning person at all!

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have been coding since high school and have developed a strong foundation in programming languages like Python and Java. My interest in technology was sparked by gaming, which led me to learn more about how software and games are developed. I am mostly self-taught, supplemented by formal education through my computer science courses.
